title: The Green Gates

nodes.title: Standard roll
nodes.body: On one long A: give the note a moment, cut near the start, tap later, and keep A after the tap. The note itself stays A. Then the tune.

nodes.title: The Green Gates
nodes.body: The reel, slowed. Play it plain, then the roll only where it is marked. A bar that will not sit: that bar alone, then with the notes before it, then the line. G is a place this tune likes a roll.

source: Traditional reel. Francis O’Neill, The Dance Music of Ireland (1907), no. 764; also O’Neill’s Music of Ireland (1903), no. 1550, as The Women’s Rock. Setting written for this pack, in D, slowed. Standard roll on a long note first.
